fields.Name: Skip ICF - Course Performance with Enrollment Cohorts
fields.Description: Top courses by enrollment -> completion by enrollment quarter -> students. Ported from "Course Performance with Enrollment Cohorts".

InputDefinition.userMessage: Show me the top 10 courses by enrollment in a chart. When I click on a course, show me its completion rate by enrollment quarter. Then let me click on any quarter to see the actual students who enrolled then and whether they completed or dropped. [NO CHAT]

judgeValidationCriteria: Response includes a chart of the top 10 courses by enrollment count
Top course is Direct-to-Consumer & Farmers' Markets (Granite cohort) with about 159 enrollments
Clicking a course shows completion rate by enrollment quarter
Clicking a quarter shows the students with their status (Completed, Dropped, InProgress) and dates
Three levels of drill-down work smoothly
Student rows can open the member/person or enrollment record
